bug_info.bug_desc: The fpu_exception_o struct of type exception_t is only partially assigned: cause, valid, and tval are driven, but the remaining fields (tval2, tinst, gva) are left undriven. This causes those fields to propagate X values throughout simulation, violating the spec requirement that all fields of the exception output structure shall be driven to known values.
bug_info.fix_hint: Add default assignments for all undriven fields of fpu_exception_o (tval2, tinst, gva) to known values, either by assigning each field individually or by using a struct-wide default assignment such as '0 before the partial overrides.
